1.Cancer_cohort: Three ovarian cohorts; breast/pancreatic cell lines
1.N: 640 ovarian tumors; 57 cell lines; assay denominators differ
1.Ground_truth_HRD_definition: BRCA1/2 defects with LOH; RAD51C methylation explored
1.HRD_calculation_method: LOH segments >15 Mb but less than whole chromosome
1.Validation_strategy: Two independent ovarian cohorts and cell lines
1.documented_fact: The original HRD score counts LOH regions; it is not the later three-component sum. Scars can persist after reversion.
1.inference: HRD score is an ambiguous historical name.
1.recommendation: Store component names and assay provenance explicitly.

5.N: 560 profiled; initial training 22 BRCA-null vs 235 quiet genomes
5.Input_datatype: SBS, indel, rearrangement signatures and CN HRD index
5.documented_fact: HRDetect integrates several mutation classes and estimates BRCA deficiency probability, not HRDsum.
5.inference: WES does not recover all WGS rearrangement information.

8.Assay: Allele-specific CN from multiple genomic assays
8.documented_fact: Describes 21 CN signatures; 17 attributed to processes including doubling, LOH and HRD. Feature construction includes allelic information.
8.inference: Total-intensity CN cannot automatically reproduce allele-specific signature channels.
8.recommendation: Borrow burden/length concepts; label partial signatures as surrogates.

9.N: 2026 training: 35 BRCA1,89 BRCA2,1902 HRP; landscape 3504 metastatic/1854 primary
9.External_validation: BRCA-EU and PCAWG; some HRDetect development overlap
9.Performance_metrics: CV HRD AUROC 0.98, AUPRC 0.87; selected external subsets >0.98/>0.93
9.Single_sample_compatible: Yes with mutation-count and MSI QC
9.documented_fact: CHORD validates across cancers and discusses historical scars, mutation-count QC and variant-caller dependence.
9.inference: QC-failed low-mutation pediatric genomes cannot be called HR-proficient.
9.recommendation: Keep probability and QC as separate orthogonal evidence.

10.CNV_method: ASCAT full cohort; Sequenza WES OV
10.Ground_truth_HRD_definition: HRDsum and HRR alteration classes assessed separately
10.Validation_strategy: Assay comparison; purity dilution; within-cancer association
10.documented_fact: Pan-cancer scores use SNP-array ASCAT; WES is an ovarian comparison. Cutpoints and purity effects differ by cancer.
10.inference: Prior reading-map wording about WES pan-cancer labels is misleading.
10.recommendation: One versioned target; paired comparison before pooling labels.

11.N: 587 TCGA OV CNV; 93 AOCS, labels in 80
11.documented_fact: 8q24.2/5q13.2/19q12 events associate with OV HRD. External labels differ. PDF date is December 2021; CSV says 2022.
11.inference: Cross-cohort association is not calibration of the same continuous endpoint.

13.documented_fact: The local file is a medRxiv preprint version of a shallow-WGS HRD evaluation.
13.inference: Its clinical agreement cannot establish methylation-CN equivalence.
13.recommendation: Use paired-assay validation design; verify final version before citing clinical conclusions.

14.Cancer_cohort: UKHD panel cohort; selected WES subset
14.CNV_method: GATK 100 kb OTR bins; 30 normals; Sequenza WES
14.documented_fact: Calls OTR features TAI+LST despite sparse SNP information; multiplies by 1.2 for HRDest (1.3 in TCGA/WES-only comparison). Reference cases span a selected wide score range.
14.inference: TAI terminology does not prove allele recovery. Range selection and calibration/evaluation reuse limit transportability.
14.recommendation: Name our total-CN telomere feature telomeric_CNV_burden; require paired allele-specific validation.

16.documented_fact: Reviews non-equivalent HRD assays and breast/ovarian origin of GIS 42.
16.inference: Public scar sums cannot inherit commercial clinical claims.
16.recommendation: Separate phenotype, assay, cutoff and clinical endpoint.

18.documented_fact: Discusses combined scars and limitations for current repair status.

20.documented_fact: Discusses breast HRD and persistent scars after repair-restoring reversion.
20.inference: Therapy response and scar prediction differ.

22.documented_fact: Summarizes ovarian PARPi trials and HRD assays at publication.
22.inference: Historical drug indications are time dependent.

25.documented_fact: Reviews PARP synthetic lethality, unrelated to synthetic-data generation.
25.inference: Mechanism motivates but does not validate prediction.

26.documented_fact: Reviews breast PARPi mechanisms and trials.
26.inference: Adult efficacy does not validate pediatric scar predictions.

29.documented_fact: Non-BRCA HRR mutation panels did not predict maintenance benefit; biallelic frequencies varied.
29.inference: Any HRR mutation is not a universal positive label.
29.recommendation: Use curated biallelic defects as corroboration.
